items.defectStatement: test_installation_not_found supplies an invalid OAuth state, so its generic error assertion passes on state rejection without exercising the mocked installation API 404. With valid state, the current implementation reaches build_integration and reports "The GitHub installation could not be found.", so the assertion must also change.
obligations: Supply valid OAuth state so the callback advances past state validation.
Exercise the existing mocked installation-not-found response.
Assert the installation-specific failure so state rejection cannot satisfy the test.
items.notes: The finding misidentifies the missing-installation behavior at this head: GitHubInstallation advances on the initial Integration.DoesNotExist; build_integration handles the API 404. Changing only the state leaves an incorrect assertion. The frozen diff supplies the required installation-specific message.
